content: {"praised":["Excellent documentary on helicopter warfare evolution.","Helicopters’ vital role explained for non-served viewers.","Uncle loved identifying copters and insignia.","Great film footage, music of UH1 blades.","Shows troop transport, gunship, medivac development."],"criticized":["Poor quality, assembly of average clips.","Inappropriate soundtrack spoils viewing experience.","Not well put together, disappointing.","Lacks depth on machines and crews.","No mention of Australian troops."]}
